field_model.title: Model
field_model.description:
Model affects how the item is displayed/viewed.
Audio: a resource primarily intended to be heard. Examples include a music playback file format  an audio compact disc  and recorded speech or sounds.
Binary: a generic binary file for repository items that don\'t fall into any other category or cannot be shown in a browser.
Collection: a collection is an aggregation of items.
Compound object: a special type of collection where the parent item may also have complex metadata.
Digital document: an electronic file or document.
Image: a visual representation other than text, including all types of moving image and still image.
Newspaper: a special type of collection which only has Newspaper Issues for children.
Publication issue: a part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or publication volume, often numbered, usually containing a grouping of works such as articles.
Page: a page in an Electronic Paged Content Object, and should be child of Paged content.
Paged content: an Electronic Book, object with pages.
Video: a recording of visual images, usually in motion and with sound accompaniment.

field_physical_form.title: Form
field_physical_form.description: The physical format of the original resource being described. If the resource is a physical object, the physical form is recorded here. If the resource is born-digital, the original digital form is recorded here. Details of the formats of resource representations stored should be recorded on the relevant Media files.

field_pid.title: PID
field_pid.description: PID of this object in Islandora 7.x (applies to migrated objects only)

field_resource_type.title: Type
field_resource_type.description: The general nature or genre of the content of the resource. To describe the digital or physical format of the resource, use Form instead.

field_subject.title: Subject (Topical)
field_subject.description: If using separate fields to record topical, geographic, name, and temporal subjects, record topical subjects here. If not splitting subjects into to different fields, all subjects can be recorded in this field.

field_subjects_name.title: Subject (Name)
field_subjects_name.description: Any new term added by typing it here will be added to the Person taxonomy. If you need to create a new Corporate Body or Family taxonomy term, do Structure > Taxonomy > [the appropriate taxonomy] > Add terms to add terms. You may need to save this form and reload it for your terms to be available here.

field_subject_general.title: Subject
field_subject_general.description: General subjects which may include topical, geographic, temporal, and genre elements. If you wish to manage these types of subjects separately, use the more specific Subject fields.Any new term added by typing it here will be added to the Subject taxonomy. If you need to create a new term in another taxonomy, do Structure > Taxonomy > [the appropriate taxonomy] > Add terms to add terms. You may need to save this form and reload it for your terms to be available here.
